# Personalised Nutrition Plan for Yogesh

## 1. Nutritional Overview

- **Recommended Daily Calorie Range**: ~1500–1700 kcal/day  
  *This creates a modest caloric deficit (~500 kcal) aligned with safe weight loss while supporting blood sugar control.*

- **Key Macronutrient Targets**:  
  - **Carbohydrates**: 45–55% of calories → ~200g/day (focus on low-GI sources)  
  - **Protein**: 25–35% of calories → ~125–145g/day (supports muscle preservation and satiety)  
  - **Fat**: 20–30% of calories → ~40–55g/day (emphasise heart‑healthy fats)

- **Micronutrients to Prioritise**:  
  - **Chromium & Magnesium**: Help improve insulin sensitivity.  
  - **Vitamin D & Calcium**: Support bone health; many people with Type 2 diabetes have lower levels.  
  - **Fiber**: Aids glycemic control and promotes fullness.
